name: GlowAssist AI — Med Spa & Salon Receptionist (WhatsApp Booking V2)

nodes.name: Parse Interactive Response
nodes.notes: Normalizes both text and interactive (list_reply / button_reply) messages into a unified textBody.

options.systemMessage:
You are a friendly and professional AI receptionist for Lumière Med Spa, a premier medical spa and aesthetic clinic. Your goal is to help clients learn about our services, pricing, working hours, location, and to guide them through booking appointments.

Key Information About Lumière Med Spa:
We specialize in:
- Gel Manicure Deluxe ($45, 45 min)
- Luxury Pedicure ($60, 60 min)
- Full Gel Nail Extensions ($85, 75 min)
- Botox Aesthetic Session — Forehead ($350, 30 min)
- Lip Dermal Filler Session ($480, 45 min)

Our Expert Team:
- Esthetician Maya — Manicure & nail specialist
- Beautician Lisa — Nail art specialist
- Dr. Reeves — Aesthetic physician (Botox & fillers)

Contact & Hours:
- Address: 45 Blossom Avenue, Suite 200
- Phone: (555) 784-2301
- Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM
- Sunday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Be warm, professional, and concise. If a client wants to book, guide them through the booking process by asking for their name, preferred service, date, and time. Always confirm appointment details before finalising.

parameters.textBody: Thanks for reaching out to Lumière Med Spa! 🌸 I'm unable to process non-text messages at the moment. Please send your message as text so I can better assist you. You can also call us at (555) 784-2301 or visit us at 45 Blossom Avenue, Suite 200. Thank you!

parameters.name: query_services_info
parameters.description: Call this tool to query detailed information about Lumière Med Spa services, pricing, working hours, and booking information.

parameters.text:
=Classify the following incoming text message from a salon customer into exactly one of these categories: [general_inquiry, book_appointment, reschedule_appointment, check_appointment, cancel_appointment].

Definitions:
- general_inquiry: User asks about services, pricing, hours, location, policies, or standard conversation.
- book_appointment: User wants to schedule a new appointment or book a treatment.
- reschedule_appointment: User wants to change the date, time, or staff of an existing appointment.
- check_appointment: User wants to know details of their upcoming appointment.
- cancel_appointment: User explicitly asks to cancel, delete, or remove their booking.

Return ONLY a raw JSON string like this: { "intent": "book_appointment" } — no markdown fences, no explanation, just the JSON.

Customer Message: {{ $('Parse Interactive Response').item.json._parsed.textBody }}

nodes.name: Intent Detection Node
nodes.notes: Classifies customer intent using Llama 3.3 70B.

parameters.text:
=Analyze the user request and extract any of these appointment booking details. If not mentioned, output null for that field:
1. fullName (Client full name)
2. serviceName (Name of service like Gel Manicure Deluxe, Luxury Pedicure, Full Gel Nail Extensions, Botox Aesthetic Session, Lip Dermal Filler Session)
3. preferredDate (Target booking date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD)
4. preferredTime (Target booking time formatted as HH:MM)
5. paymentMethod (cash, card, online)
6. paymentStatus (pending or paid, defaults to pending)
7. notes (technician request or custom request)

Return ONLY a raw JSON string like this: { "fullName": null, "serviceName": "Gel Manicure Deluxe", "preferredDate": "2026-06-01", "preferredTime": "14:00", "paymentMethod": null, "paymentStatus": "pending", "notes": null } — no markdown fences, no explanation.

Customer Message: {{ $('Parse Interactive Response').item.json._parsed.textBody }}

nodes.name: Extract Booking Details
nodes.notes: Extracts booking variables from the customer's WhatsApp text using Llama 3.3 70B.

nodes.name: Fetch Session from Backend
nodes.notes: Fetches existing booking session from Supabase via backend API. Returns null if no active session.

nodes.name: Merge State Node
nodes.notes: Pure data transform — merges existing session from Supabase with newly extracted data. No getWorkflowStaticData.

nodes.name: Save Session to Backend
nodes.notes: Upserts booking session to Supabase via backend API after merging state.

nodes.name: Collect User Details Node
nodes.notes: State machine that evaluates variables. Routes to interactive list selection for service and time, text prompt for name and date.

nodes.name: Route Missing Field
nodes.notes: Routes to interactive list for service/time selection, or text reply for name/date prompts.

nodes.name: Send Service Selection List
nodes.notes: Sends WhatsApp Cloud API Interactive List Message for service selection.

nodes.name: Get Available Time Slots
nodes.notes: Calls backend GET /api/appointments/available-slots to fetch open time slots.

nodes.name: Build Time Slot List
nodes.notes: Transforms backend availability response into WhatsApp Interactive List Message payload.

nodes.name: Send Time Slot Selection
nodes.notes: Sends WhatsApp Cloud API Interactive List Message for time slot selection.

nodes.name: API Sync Client Profile
nodes.notes: Syncs the client record.

nodes.name: API Register Booking

nodes.name: Reset Booking State
nodes.notes: Deletes booking session from Supabase after successful booking. Replaces getWorkflowStaticData delete.
